name: new-sources-probe
description: Throwaway probe: checks from a real GitHub Actions runner IP whether Quatru (BPI-affiliated real estate marketplace) and e-leiloes.pt (official OSAE judicial auction platform) are reachable with a plain HTTP fetch, what their real URL/category structure looks like, whether listing data is present in the raw HTML, and whether a modest burst of requests trips any rate-limit/block response. Not part of the production scraper.
